Screen disease pairs for influential impact interactions

Source: R/sensitivity.R
screen_interactions.Rd

Adds a pairwise interaction of each size in values to each disease pair, one at a time, re-runs the global adjustment and reports the change in the aggregate and rankings. The joint distribution is fitted once and reused.

Usage

screen_interactions(model, values, pairs = NULL, valuation = NULL, ...)

Arguments

model

A cm_model().

values

Interaction sizes (same units as the impacts; positive synergistic, negative antagonistic).

pairs

Optional character vector of pairs ("d1:d2").

valuation

Optional valuation list; otherwise the adjusted aggregate is the metric.

...

Passed to fit_joint() (e.g. backend = "sampled" for many diseases).

Value

A cm_screen data frame as in screen_associations().
